decisive_items: Heterozygous pathogenic variant of TBK1 gene (p.E643del)
response.rationale: TBK1 pathogenic variant plus frontotemporal-parkinsonian features (cognitive impairment, vertical gaze palsy, basal ganglia DAT loss) best fit the overall syndrome; ALS features are also present but fall within the TBK1-associated FTD-ALS spectrum.

rejected.why: Explains vertical gaze palsy and DAT loss but not the TBK1 variant or bulbar denervation on EMG.
Explains tongue atrophy, EMG, and TBK1 but not vertical gaze palsy or caudate-predominant DAT loss.
